items.subject: EV charger install ù question about panel capacity
items.message: Before we book: my panel is 100A. Is that enough for a Level 2 charger at 40A without upgrading? The electrician did mention this on the quote call but I want it in writing.

items.subject: After-visit: the tech was excellent
items.message: Just wanted to say the tech who came for the fridge was excellent ù solved it in 20 minutes and explained everything. we'd request him again.

items.subject: General: do you service tankless water heaters?
items.message: Hi, do you work on tankless water heaters? Have a Rinnai from 2018 that may need descaling. Thanks!

items.subject: Re: AC service ù would like to confirm 4-hour window
items.message: Thanks for the AI follow-up. To confirm: this Friday between 1-5pm? Someone needs to be home; I can be.

items.subject: Outdoor outlet replacement ù ready to schedule
items.message: It's been 8 months since we talked about the outdoor outlet. I'd like to finally book it. weather is fine. Any weekday works.

items.subject: Furnace won't start ù house is 60F
items.message: It's cold and the furnace just won't kick in. we've tried the thermostat, circuit breaker, and igniter button. Nothing. we have a baby and elderly parent here. Need someone today.

items.subject: Did anyone confirm my appt last Friday?
items.message: Hi, my quarterly AC tune-up was last Friday and I haven't gotten a confirmation that it actually happened or any post-visit summary. Can someone follow up?

items.subject: Bathroom leak is BACK ù I'm ready to escalate
items.message: we had a leak fixed 15 days ago. It came back yesterday and is worse. The same plumber came both times. I want to talk to a manager about what is going on. Photos attached. I expect this resolved without further invoicing.

items.subject: Toilet running constantly, would like a quote
items.message: The toilet on the second floor has been running every 5 minutes for about a week. Looking for a quote to fix it ù no rush, just want it done before guests arrive next month.

items.subject: Quarterly AC maintenance ù schedule October visit
items.message: Hi! Fall maintenance is coming up and I'd like to schedule. I'm flexible any weekday morning in the next two weeks. Also: the upstairs filter has been replaced by me ù can the tech confirm that's the right MERV rating when they come?

items.subject: Sparks from kitchen outlet ù please advise immediately
items.message: Our kitchen outlet sparked when I unplugged the toaster. There's a small burn mark on the outlet plate. we have flipped the breaker for that outlet. I don't want to use it until someone has looked.

items.subject: Same water heater issue AGAIN
items.message: I'm sorry to be back. The water heater you guys fixed two weeks ago is leaking again from the same spot. we have no hot water this morning. This is the third time in 12 months.

items.subject: Refrigerator leaking water onto the floor
items.message: water has been pooling under our fridge for two days now. Looks like a small lake in the morning. we haven't moved it yet because the water line is suspicious ù please advise.

items.subject: AC not cooling upstairs, urgent
items.message: Hi, our upstairs AC stopped cooling around 11pm last night. we have a baby and it's already 78 upstairs. Can someone come today? Two-story home, the upstairs unit is the one that died; downstairs is fine.
